items.q: What does a self-improving factory review?
items.a: Every past agent **conversation with tool calls and outputs**.
**LLM-as-judge rubrics** (e.g. efficiency, verbosity, redundant tests) with pass/fail bounds.
Finds failure **patterns across sessions** and opens **PRs to patch skills/config**.

items.q: Example fix from a graded session?
items.a: Missing **sub-agent spawn config** in a triage skill → wasted tool calls.
Meta-work to improve the **system that drives the agents**, not only the feature wheel.
